tools.name: wait_for_message
tools.description: Event-driven blocking call that waits for a matching incoming SMS to arrive and unblocks immediately. Does not busy-poll SQLite.

after.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds; only messages received after this timestamp match

sender.description: Optional sender address or phone number to filter by (e.g. 'BANK')

timeout.description: Maximum duration to wait in seconds (default: 30, max: 300)

tools.name: get_otp
tools.description: Waits for an incoming verification SMS and extracts the numeric/alphanumeric OTP code via regex (default: \b\d{4,8}\b).

regex.description: Optional regex pattern with capture group for OTP extraction (default: \b\d{4,8}\b)

sender.description: Optional sender address to wait for (e.g. 'GOOGLE', 'CHASE')

timeout.description: Maximum duration to wait in seconds (default: 30, max: 300)

tools.name: get_latest_message
tools.description: Fetches the single most recent stored SMS, optionally filtered by sender.

sender.description: Optional sender address or phone number to filter by

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Queries stored SMS messages with sender, device ID, timestamp, and pagination limit filters.

after.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds; returns messages received after this timestamp

deviceId.description: Filter by originating Android device ID

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Performs safe substring search across stored message bodies and sender addresses.

limit.description: Maximum search results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

query.description: Keyword or text to search for
